intro: One of the most-asked questions for this trip: how do you actually get from Krabi to Krabi? Here are your options compared, with the honest pick for most travelers.

blocks.html: Short answer: From Krabi to Koh Lanta, a minivan plus car ferry runs year-round, taking about 1.5–2 hours including the crossing. A speedboat is a bit faster but only runs in high season (Nov–Apr). Traveling as a group, a private car charter to your hotel is also convenient.

blocks.caption: Options compared (฿ = relative cost; check live fares to confirm)

blocks.html: Outside high season, the minivan plus car ferry is the main option and runs year-round. If traveling Nov–Apr and want to save time, the speedboat is a bit faster. Traveling as a group or with young kids, a private car charter is easiest since there is no need to switch vehicles.

faq.q: How long is Krabi to Koh Lanta?
faq.a: A minivan plus car ferry takes about 1.5–2 hours including the wait. A high-season speedboat is a bit faster, around 1–1.5 hours.

faq.q: Can I visit Koh Lanta in the rainy season?
faq.a: Yes — the minivan-plus-ferry route runs year-round, though speedboats usually stop running May–Oct, and some accommodation on the island closes seasonally. Check before booking.
